help: PAID — the model reads the corpus for semantic-concepts + chat-categories (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

args.name: --conversations
args.help: source override: a markdown corpus dir | a json/ dir | a conversations.json

args.name: --only
args.help: limit the paid capture to semantic-concepts | chat-categories

args.name: --dry-run
args.help: print the coverage this capture would re-read, and stop — spends nothing, needs no API key

sends: PAID: POSTs the corpus to api.anthropic.com, twice (semantic-concepts, chat-categories); --dry-run sends nothing and works under YOGA_NO_SEND (refused loudly otherwise)
